parts:
https://jimmywildedev.shinyapps.io/PredictiveUnderwriting/

Trying to deploy my first ShinyApp to shinyapps.io
Works fine locally, but when I deploy it greys out with "Disconnected from the Server" after approx 3 secs.
Log is showing a gnutls_handshake() failed error - which looks like it may relate to getURL and subsequent read.csv from raw github file.

Details are below would be grateful for any help.

Thanks

Jimmy
